# Pull Request

## What changed

Describe the user-visible behavior and why it changed.

## Verification

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated the README, Vim help, and changelog when the public interface changed.
- [ ] I checked visible shortcuts and `?` help after changing a UI action.
- [ ] Fixtures and logs contain no personal flashcard data or machine-specific secrets.
- [ ] I documented any relevant check I could not run.
